notes.note: Re-recorded after merging origin/main into the combined chat phone-fixes branch. The record was taken from main, where it was reviewed with the pull-request push-owner change (sourceOwner and pushTargetOwner in docs/reference/contracts.md). The sources that differ from that record (docs/reference/contracts.md, packages/contracts/src/engine-capability-matrix.ts, src-server/runtime/routes/runtime-routes.ts) carry this branch's changes: the optional toolKind on tool events and request.opened, the attachment refusal code and composer image-support caveat, steerInterruptedRun, and the contracts reference paragraphs describing them. This document was already reviewed against those changes on this branch before the merge. Both sides' edits to docs/reference/contracts.md are in separate paragraphs and merged without conflict; I read the merged file and both sets of paragraphs are present and do not contradict each other. No other source listed here was changed by main in this merge. No claim changes from the combination.
